releaseName: Numbers you can read at a glance
notes: New type throughout. Amounts are now set in JetBrains Mono, which was designed for reading figures quickly — a zero can’t be mistaken for an eight, and columns line up properly.
Headings and labels move to Sora, which sits better alongside those numbers than the previous pairing did.

Fixed: your largest figures — the progress percentage, the monthly totals, the leftover amount — were falling back to the wrong typeface because of a style rule that pointed at something that was never defined.
